title: Itna bhi nahi sonchte bimaar hoon baba
body:
mai touq o salasal me giraftaar hu'n baba
<<MINI>>
itna bhi nahi sonchte bimaar hu'n baba
<<DIVIDER>>
ab itni naqahat hai ke ghash khata hu'n baba
durra koi lagta hai to girjaata hu'n baba
be-monis o be-yaar o madadgaar hu'n baba
<<MINI>>
itna bhi nahi sonchte bimaar hu'n baba
<<DIVIDER>>
bechain sa rehta hu'n mai zakhmau'n ke sabab se
lagta hai nikal jayegi ab rooh badan se
zinda hu'n magar jeene se bezaar hu'n baba
<<MINI>>
itna bhi nahi sonchte bimaar hu'n baba
<<DIVIDER>>
jab khaati hai chehre pa wo zalim ke tamache
takti hai badi yaas se chehre ko hamare
dil gham se phata jaata hai ghamkhaar hu'n baba
<<MINI>>
itna bhi nahi sonchte bimaar hu'n baba
<<DIVIDER>>
sar nange hai zainab to laee'n haste hai'n saare
sar uthta nahi baba mera sharm ke maare
bewaao'n ka mai qafila salaar hu'n baba
<<MINI>>
itna bhi nahi sonchte bimaar hu'n baba
<<DIVIDER>>
har gaam pe hota hai sitam mujhpe nirala
bejurm o khata khaata hu'n barchhi kabhi bhaala
mai aapki nusrat ka talabgaar hu'n baba
<<MINI>>
itna bhi nahi sonchte bimaar hu'n baba
<<DIVIDER>>
kuch aise mujhe jakda hai zanjeer e sitam se
mumkin nahi behlau'n sakina ko jo badhke
abid ne kaha bekas o lachaar hu'n baba
<<MINI>>
itna bhi nahi sonchte bimaar hu'n baba
<<DIVIDER>>
be aab o ghiza saath moharram se sakina
har gaam sitam sehti hai haaye wo yateema
is gham se mai jaa'n dene ko tayyaar hu'n baba
<<MINI>>
itna bhi nahi sonchte bimaar hu'n baba
<<DIVIDER>>
hai touqe gara'n halq me aur pusht me langar
ab kisse kaho sadme utha ta hu'n jo dil par
hai tum ko khabar tanha hu'n be-yaar hu'n baba
<<MINI>>
itna bhi nahi sonchte bimaar hu'n baba
<<DIVIDER>>
hai zakhmi badan uspe ghazab pyaas ki shiddat
chalne ki nahi jism me do gaam bhi quwwat
halat ye hai ab marne ko tayyar hu'n baba
<<MINI>>
itna bhi nahi sonchte bimaar hu'n baba
<<DIVIDER>>
beparda jo bazaar me sab ahle haram hai'n
mai sharm se marjau'n ye mere liye kam hai
aajao ke be yawar o ansaarhu'n baba
<<MINI>>
itna bhi nahi sonchte bimaar hu'n baba
<<DIVIDER>>
har waqt qamar lab pe the sajjad ke naale
har gaam sahu'n kaise ye gham paalne waale
maa behne khule sar hai mai lachaar hu'n baba
<<MINI>>
itna bhi nahi sonchte bimaar hu'n baba
